description: A serial-in, parallel-out shift register. Module `sipo` with inputs clk, rst_n (active-low reset), din and shift, and an 8-bit output q. At each rising clock edge where shift is 1, q shifts left by one and din enters at bit 0 (so the first bit shifted in ends up as the most significant after 8 shifts). With shift 0, q holds. Reset clears q.
